scope: 31 implemented player spells; data-only, disabled recipes and enemy attacks excluded
grading_policy: Current grades require candidate-bound full-sequence assessment. User feedback is calibration, not a substitute for unobserved categories. Historical grades are not copied forward. Fantasy fulfillment must be established separately from the arithmetic mean.
required_evidence: native full-sequence motion and actual contacts
meaningful base/max rank or explicit non-applicability
crowded moving encounter with another spell and hostile threat
candidate revision and verified viewable artifacts

rows.name: Bolt
rows.next_review: Preserve the fast minimal projectile. Tighten the staff-tip release and give the real contact one clean directional spark rather than a larger explosion.

rows.name: Life
rows.user_feedback: Actual-heal pulse merged; no user acceptance.
rows.next_review: Assess full sequence and audible recovery cue at gameplay scale.

rows.name: Regeneration
rows.user_feedback: Quiet aura and actual recovery gathers merged; no user acceptance.
rows.next_review: Assess sustained rhythm, crowded visibility and audible cue.

rows.name: Ice Blast
rows.user_feedback: User approved base and max-rank visual previews.
rows.next_review: Qualify audio and crowded readability without redesigning accepted fan.

rows.name: Earth Shield
rows.next_review: Make one protective stone shell assemble, visibly take the incoming hit, then break into the existing eruption. The single charge should look spent afterward.

rows.name: Lightning
rows.user_feedback: User rated restored bolt, circle and explosion effects A; preserve visual identity.
rows.next_review: Complete moving/crowded encounter, sound and camera evidence.

rows.name: Meteor Shower
rows.user_feedback: User explicitly likes staggered falls and repeated impact shakes.
rows.next_review: Verify sound and crowded readability while preserving stagger.

rows.name: Ember Spear
rows.next_review: Preserve heat, reach and force. Break up the strip into an irregular scorched path with moving low flame, keeping the spear head distinct from its damaging wake.

rows.name: Infestation
rows.latest_reviewed_change: dev.27 candidate: attached infection lesions and coherent transmission
rows.user_feedback: No user grade or acceptance of this candidate. Prior floating black block material rejected during internal review.
rows.next_review: Provisional native-sequence assessment: attached lesions and real travelling seed improve sickness identity, but attachment/tick emphasis is still understated (fantasy and impact C+); clean material and purposeful travel B-; host preservation B. Sound artistic judgment U. Finish audible assessment and mixed hostile/other-spell/modifier coverage before assigning any passing overall grade.

rows.name: Cinder Field
rows.next_review: Keep the heat and saturated color. Emphasize glowing coal pockets, low licking flame and hot ash stirred at real damage contacts; let the edge cool unevenly.

rows.name: Arcane Orbit
rows.next_review: Keep two clear bodies and their orbit. Let light circulate within each shell and leave a short curved particle wake; concentrate the contact accent on the leading edge.

rows.name: Focus Ray
rows.next_review: Keep the clean beam. Add subtle forward flow and a concentrated contact point that responds to real ticks, plus a brief narrowing shutdown rather than extra screen effects.

rows.name: Rune Trap
rows.next_review: Keep the runic geometry. Draw the inscription once, wait quietly, then snap its symbols inward during the actual trigger warning before the blast opens outward.

rows.name: Seeker
rows.user_feedback: Hybrid reference accepted B-minus; sustained hunt and gentle healing return approved.
rows.next_review: Verify full native hunt, fresh-target finish and healing lifecycle at ranks with audio.

rows.name: Fire Walk
rows.next_review: Keep the ground-hugging scale. Connect neighboring flames through short-lived heat and embers, show ignition directly behind each step, and let older patches cool in path order.

rows.name: Cross Blade
rows.user_feedback: Filled steel candidate merged; no user acceptance.
rows.next_review: Assess motion and real contacts with audio in crowded play.

rows.name: Lightning Bolt
rows.next_review: Make each projectile contact leave a compact electrical mark that visibly becomes its delayed sky strike. Preserve the cascade while shortening distracting spent-ring emphasis.

rows.name: Life Bolt
rows.next_review: Use a small planted sprout for available recovery and reserve the inward warm pulse for actual healing. Preserve the offensive projectile; do not make damaging contact look like healing the enemy.

rows.name: Meteor Spear
rows.next_review: Keep penetration and staggered follow-up impacts. Mark the pierced contacts briefly, then make each descending meteor visibly answer a mark; refine the same artificial trail edge as Ember Spear.

rows.name: Soul Bloom
rows.user_feedback: Approved hybrid port is merged; user explicitly likes Soul Bloom.
rows.next_review: Verify native spread, spirit emergence, full-health alternative and audio.

rows.name: Steam Field
rows.user_feedback: User liked steam particle direction; retain cloud identity.
rows.next_review: Complete audible/crowded burn feedback assessment.

rows.name: Prism Ray
rows.next_review: Make a bright compact refraction knot at the real split, maintain a confident primary ray and give branches lighter material tails. Keep the rainbow fan rather than sanitizing away the fantasy.

rows.name: Frost Sigil
rows.next_review: Preserve the forceful trigger. Make frost race along the inscription and burst into brittle fragments; fade into cold rime rather than a burnt-looking patch.

rows.name: Magic Missile
rows.user_feedback: Diamond direction selected; tiny edge/contact polish not explicitly graded by user.
rows.next_review: Judge latest polish independently of rejected earlier grades.

rows.name: Bare Spear
rows.next_review: Keep one sharp point, short wake and local puncture. Reduce competing generic cast decoration before adding anything to the projectile.

rows.name: Bare Slash
rows.next_review: Keep the quick cone. Concentrate light at an advancing curved edge and taper the tail, with clipped contact particles; do not reintroduce the rejected painted treatment.

rows.name: Bare Nova
rows.next_review: Let the damaging front own the release, with a compact central compression and localized edge contacts. Keep the inside quiet after the wave passes.

rows.name: Bare Field
rows.next_review: Preserve the compact rune field. Ground the glyphs and let real ticks produce a restrained outward pulse instead of constant equally bright decoration.

rows.name: Bare Orbit
rows.next_review: Keep this restrained scale and readable orbit. Give actual contacts a tiny leading-edge spark and retire each wake naturally when its body expires.

rows.name: Bare Trap
rows.next_review: Use one short closing inscription to signal armed, a quiet waiting state, and one snap on trigger. Empty expiry should erase it without a blast.

rows.name: Atomic
rows.user_feedback: Atomic reference inferred as I Am Atomic; violet material candidate merged, no user acceptance.
rows.next_review: Review audible mix and mixed hostile-threat encounter.
